ordered_step_reconstruction: STRUCTURE, FULL-RELAY, SELFCONSISTENCY, INTERNAL-PHASE-R8, and frozen R8 amplitude identities place every max n=2 self-consistent point in the strict four-event chart with Eo=0; R9 makes it reflection fixed.

The package-local R13 half-angle certificate proves detct>0 throughout that chamber. Its amplitude cone, norm compression, reciprocal identities, original mu partials, and 1200-positive-coefficient determinant proof do not assume det G_x.

For fixed r, detct>0 makes every common-terminal component a single mu graph. Strict Rayleigh comparison bounds mu; exhaustive endpoint classification gives lower endpoint at least 3/2, including theta->0/mu->1 simultaneous corners and the legal upper-phase closure. Hence every interior root has mu>3/2.

The scalar N_L lemma is positive on the resulting phase range. The low-coordinate phase Jacobian is a strict M-matrix. Separate left and right one-end gauges differ from the original norm row only by multiples of dh1 and dh2 respectively, so they preserve the correct individual minors and give B1<0<B2.
Expansion using the original Eo row gives detall=detct Eo_mu-h2_mu B1+h1_mu B2>0. The R12/R13 orientation transformations then give Omega_2>0.

Common-terminal regularity is proved independently: the map (t,theta,e)->(Aamp,theta,Aamp Camp-1) has positive determinant, and on dz=0 the terminal rows are negative positive-factor multiples of dh1,dh2. Thus det G_x is a strict positive factor times detct, so no regularity premise is circularly imported.
After regularity is established, Omega_2=det(G_x)^2 dot(mathcal E) and c'=dot(mathcal E)/(2mu^2 I_U^h) give c'>0.

Canonical L_+>0 and PARAMETER-ACTION-R1 combine with audited R11 equations (4.5), (5.15), and (6.16): L'<0 and c'>0 make the frequency Schur scalar negative, so the full max shape Hessian is strictly negative.
Canonical H=diag(delta_i)D_xG with every delta_i=+/- (R-1) nonzero converts H<0 into nonsingularity of the full max n=2 switch residual at every self-consistent point.
